method.name: full-resolution T1ce + frozen SAM click-3 logit residual refiner
method.input: N4-corrected T1ce and tanh(frozen click-3 SAM raw logit / 5)
method.interaction: 3 accumulated GT-derived corrective clicks with recurrent low-resolution mask
method.threshold: raw logit > 0 for coarse and refined predictions

interpretation.development_to_test: The test refined DSC is higher than validation because the same-run coarse test DSC is also higher; the paired refiner gain is +0.037140, close to the validation gain +0.032450.
interpretation.size_effect: The refiner gives no aggregate gain for the 10 smallest test crops below 8000 WT voxels, while all three larger strata improve by approximately +0.0376 to +0.0429.
interpretation.automatic_system_boundary: This is an oracle GT-centered result. The strongest completed automatic test result remains the nonzero brain-crop arm at 0.625359 under its older matched protocol.

evidence_boundary: This is a GT-centered/oracle-localization test and cannot be presented as an automatic end-to-end segmentation score.
It uses the older N4/native-resolution/three-click branch, not official15/five-click preprocessing and interaction.
The 270-case internal test was already revealed by earlier project arms and is not pristine external validation.
The test result was not used for checkpoint selection, threshold search, TTA, morphology, connected-component filtering, or any adaptation.
The raw Dice values across official15, brain-crop, and this refiner are descriptive milestones, not a single-factor ablation table.
